title: Typhoon Haikui warning: Kaohsiung port expected closed
description: Taiwan's Central Weather Administration issued a sea warning for Typhoon Haikui. Kaohsiung port authority expects to suspend operations for 4-5 days starting in 48 hours.

title: Power rationing ordered for southern Taiwan industrial zones
description: Taiwan's grid operator ordered rotating power cuts for heavy industrial users in Kaohsiung after typhoon damage to a substation. Plants expect to run at about half capacity for 8 days.

title: Fire at Yantian-area industrial park, Shenzhen
description: A fire at an industrial park in Shenzhen's Yantian district has halted operations at several electronics plants. Local authorities estimate a 7-day safety shutdown.

title: Dockworker strike announced at Haiphong port
description: Port workers' union in Haiphong, Vietnam announced a strike over wages starting Monday, expected to last about 8 days.

title: New gallium export licensing rules tightened
description: New export licensing requirements for gallium compounds take effect in 30 days, with processing times reported at 45-60 days.
